fields.description:
Pre-Due — reminder before the due date for standard (non-withholding) invoices.
After Overdue — recurring reminders for standard invoices that are past due.
Withholding Tax — reminders for invoices marked Outstanding is W/H, using flexible date rules (not tied to overdue).
fields.label: Reminder Type

fields.description: Only submitted Sales Invoices with this Payment Terms Template are included. Must match the invoice field exactly (case differences may still match on case-insensitive databases).
fields.label: Payment Terms Template

fields.description: Number of days before the invoice due date to send the reminder. Example: 3 sends when due date is 3 days from today.
fields.label: Days Before Due

fields.description: Applies to standard invoices only (Outstanding is W/H is not ticked). Invoices must be past due (plus grace) before reminders start. Use After Overdue Condition to decide which invoices still qualify.
fields.label: After Overdue Reminder

fields.description: Grace period after the due date before the first overdue reminder is sent (T+X days).
fields.label: Days After Overdue

fields.description: Use the grace period (T+X) from Sales Invoice Penalty Settings instead of the value above.
fields.label: Use Penalty Grace Period

fields.description:
Optional Python expression. Leave blank to use the default: flt(outstanding_amount) > 1. Grace period is already controlled by Days After Overdue / penalty settings — do not put that in the expression.
Recommended:
flt(outstanding_amount) > 1 or (flt(outstanding_penalty_amount) > 1 and not cint(penalty_paid))
Meaning: keep sending while invoice outstanding > 1; if principal is settled, keep sending only while penalty outstanding > 1 and Penalty Paid is not ticked (invoices with no penalty simply stop when outstanding ≤ 1).
Available: doc, today, posting_date, due_date, days_overdue, days_after_overdue, outstanding_amount, outstanding_penalty_amount, penalty_paid, flt, cint, add_days, getdate, date_diff.
fields.label: After Overdue Condition

fields.description: Applies to invoices with Outstanding is W/H ticked and outstanding amount greater than 1. Timing is based on posting or due date, not overdue status. So reminders can be sent before the due date.
fields.label: Withholding Tax Reminder

fields.description:
The invoice date used to decide when a withholding invoice becomes eligible for reminders.
Posting Date — invoice posting date.
Payment Due Date — invoice due date.
Withholding Date — the date Outstanding is W/H was ticked (hidden field on the invoice).
fields.label: Date Basis
fields.options:
Posting Date
Payment Due Date
Withholding Date

fields.description:
Optional Python expression (leave blank to default to: start from the 1st of the next month after Date Basis).
Available: doc, reference_date, posting_date, due_date, withholding_date, today, add_days, add_months, get_first_day, getdate, date_diff.
Example (next month start): get_first_day(add_months(reference_date, 1)) <= today
fields.label: Withholding Condition

fields.description: How often reminders are sent on eligible days (after exclusion calendar is applied).
fields.label: Frequency
Weekday
fields.options:
Monday
Tuesday
Wednesday
Thursday
Friday
Saturday
Sunday

fields.description: When enabled, uses the same excluded days as Sales Invoice Penalty Settings. Reminders are not sent on excluded days including when a weekly or monthly schedule falls on an excluded day.
fields.label: Use Penalty Exclusion Calendar
